subject: integration
name: Saved passwords (this computer)
summary: Built-in Account that keeps saved logins on this computer: each password is encrypted by the OS keyring, with the site and user name beside it in the clear, and it saves nothing without a real keyring or in a private window. It answers only list, reveal, save and remove, signs nothing, connects to nothing, and reveals a login only for the site it was saved under. Level 4 with privacy; it would drop if a login left the computer. Judged here by its publisher.
